entities.name: Nitropyridine reduction
observations: CN(C)-substituted nitropyridine converts to the corresponding aminopyridine by nitro-to-amino reduction.
Closest ORD record: 85.7% yield in ethanol at 80 °C for 30 h; sodium bicarbonate present. Reducing agent or hydrogen source is not specified.
